name: mandemarket
description: Plateforme e-commerce moderne et scalable - MandeMarket (Docker Ready)

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --build
scripts.docker:exec:postgres: docker compose exec postgres psql -U postgres -d mandemarket
scripts.docker:migrate: docker compose exec backend /app/node_modules/.bin/prisma migrate deploy
scripts.docker:debug: docker compose logs --tail=50 && docker compose ps
scripts.setup:docker: npm run docker:build && npm run docker:up && npm run docker:wait && npm run docker:migrate
scripts.fix:docker: npm run docker:down && docker system prune -f && docker network prune -f && npm run docker:up
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.db:backup: docker compose exec postgres pg_dump -U postgres mandemarket > backup_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).sql
scripts.fresh-install: npm run clean && npm run install:all
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check:frontend && npm run type-check:backend
scripts.format: cd frontend && npx prettier --write . && cd ../backend && npx prettier --write .
scripts.monitor: docker stats mandemarket-frontend mandemarket-backend mandemarket-postgres mandemarket-redis
scripts.backup:volumes: docker run --rm -v mandemarket_postgres_data:/data -v $(pwd):/backup alpine tar czf /backup/postgres_backup_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).tar.gz -C /data .

author: MandeMarket Team <dev@mandemarket.com> (https://mandemarket.com)
